query:
UPDATE project_tags SET
                   name  = CASE WHEN $2 THEN $3 ELSE name END,
                   color = CASE WHEN $4 THEN $5 ELSE color END
               WHERE id = $1
               RETURNING id AS "id!: Uuid",
                         project_id AS "project_id!: Uuid",
                         name AS "name!",
                         color AS "color!"
